art.geo.title: Where your works were used
art.geo.intro: The figures are plays of your works at venues, added up by area and period. We never say which venue played them, and we do not show an area with too few venues.
art.geo.levelHelp: The default is {level}. A finer level needs a disclosure basis approved for you.
art.geo.policy: Under geography policy version {n}, the default level is {level} and an area is shown only if it holds at least {min} venues.
art.geo.basisDefault: The policy's default level, which needs no basis of its own
art.geo.basisLapsed: Your basis for the {level} level is no longer effective, so the figure is aggregated to the default level.
art.geo.basisNone: You hold no disclosure basis for the {level} level, so the figure is aggregated to the default level. The data protection officer approves a basis for a finer level.
art.geo.atMinimum: The area holds exactly the minimum number of venues, which is enough.
art.geo.childSuppressed: Too few venues. Not added to a neighbouring area.
art.geo.noVenue: The figure names no venue and no number of venues.
art.geo.suppressedTitle: The figure for this area is suppressed
art.geo.reason.GEOGRAPHY_BELOW_MINIMUM: This area has too few venues, so we do not show a figure. Your work may still have been played there. Choose a wider area to see one.
art.geo.reason.DIFFERENCING_WOULD_DISCLO: We cannot show this figure because, with one you have already seen, it would reveal the use at a single venue. A wider area or a longer period will not help.
art.geo.reason.PREMISES_IDENTITY_NOT_DIS: We cannot tell you which venue this was.
art.geo.reason.LEVEL_NOT_PERMITTED: That level of geographic detail is not approved for artist analytics.
art.geo.identityText: Your analytics show where your work was used only at the approved level of detail. The figure below stays at that level.
art.geo.compared: Compared with a figure you saw before: {area}, {period}.
art.geo.releasedEmpty: You have not asked about an area yet.
art.geo.askAgain: There is no such area or period. Choose again from the list.
art.geo.errTitle: Where your works were used could not be loaded.
art.geo.errText: The fault is on our side. Try again in a few minutes.
